Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects add to this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
